decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed fencing at a height of 2.4 metres will not detract from the character and appearance of the conservation area and will not impact upon the amenities of adjoining residential occupiers. This is in accordance with policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development), ENV.B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and ENV.N.1.11 (Protection and Improvement of Local Open Space) of the adopted London Borough Of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Installation of 2.4 metre and 2m high railings and gates to front elevation of existing school.
